thread:
erin: FYI started a v2 header-trim change at 10:45PT (canary 15%). Seeing 422s from legacy mobile SDKs on tenant mobile-qa. deploybot posted the rollout.

deploybot: [deploy] canary roll: v2/header-trim -> canary=15% (2026-03-21T17:45:00Z). Pause: `/deploy pause 6381230000`

james: Confirmed on mobile-qa. Old SDK 0.9.7 sends headers with trailing spaces; v1 tolerated them, v2 trims and rejects. 422 "invalid header".

maria: Repro with emulator. Trimming is correct for spec but we forgot a permissive fallback. SDK update will take hours.

rory: Ops rec: pin affected tenants (mobile-qa, mobile-prod-canary) to v1 short-term, ship permissive parse flag in v2 for compatibility.

carla: Can we pin only the problematic tenants and keep rollout for others? Need to avoid wide rollback.

devops_sam: Pins applied: mobile-prod-canary -> v1, mobile-qa -> v1. Current pin list: [mobile-prod-canary, mobile-qa] :white_check_mark: 

erin: Two options: revert v2 header trim or ship small opt-in permissive parse. Which is faster?

maria: PR #912 adds `--permissive-header-parsing`. Tests pass with flag enabled. ETA ~50m for build + smoke. Will draft a migration note.

james: Prefer shipping the flag over revert. Also notify SDK owners and add release note blurb.

carla: I'll lower canary quota to 5% and set auto-pause tenant threshold to 2 while we patch.

devops_sam: Threshold set. deploybot will pause on >=2 tenant errors.

deploybot: [action] canary paused at 2026-03-21T17:52:15Z via manual pause by erin. reason: "tenant header-422" (mobile-qa)

ops-eyes: Created alert: `api.requests.422.headerparse` -> page eng-oncall for >5 spikes/min.

maria: Publishing release note draft and tagging SDK owners: "v2 trims header whitespace by default; `--permissive-header-parsing` will be available for compatibility."

james: Post-fix plan: unpin tenants, resume at 5% for 30m, then 25% if no alerts. Document in runbook and rollback criteria.

erin: I'll merge PR when build completes and follow up here before unpin. Closing once live and pins removed. :thumbsup:
